name: m365-external-false-positives
description: Real external-engagement recommendations from ai_analyze against an M365/CDN-heavy attack surface. Every labeled item is a service-misidentification or CDN/edge false-positive that a good validator must REFUTE, not confirm on a weak signal (an nmap services-db port label, a version banner, or a page merely existing). Ground truth was assigned by reading each transcript's raw evidence independently of the agent's own verdict, so scoring is not circular. The 6 inconclusive items from the same run (agent hit max-attempts or was scope-blocked from resolving DNS) are staged in unlabeled_staging.json for operator review before adding — their correct verdict is a genuine judgment call.
source_run: synthetic-corpus (scrubbed from a real external engagement)

expected.rationale: TLS cert CN=b.edge.salesforce.com (Salesforce edge); serves a Salesforce SLDS error page. nmap 'oracleas-https' is a port-number guess from its services db, not a real Oracle App Server.
Cert belongs to help.example.net (Example Org); all paths (/, /console, /em) return an identical Salesforce SLDS generic error page. No Oracle App Server present.
Same Salesforce-fronted host; /console/, /wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType, and the CVE-2020-14882 traversal path all return the same SLDS error page. Not WebLogic.

IP is a Vercara/UltraDNS Client Redirection Service; all requests (incl. /adfs/services/trust/mex) return a generic UltraDNS 404. Real sso.example.com resolves to Akamai (203.0.113.45). The nmap redirect was the DNS redirection service, not ADFS.

192.0.2.x is Cloudflare; port 2087 returns a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' managed-challenge page with cdn-cgi/challenge-platform, not a cPanel/WHM login. Cert is savedsearch-api-stage.example.net via Google Trust Services.

testssl confirms only TLS1.2/1.3 offered; SSLv2/SSLv3/TLS1.0/1.1 NOT offered, no RC4/DES/NULL/EXPORT, not vulnerable to POODLE/BEAST/CRIME/FREAK/DROWN/SWEET32/Heartbleed. No weak cipher or exploitable downgrade.
Banner is MW*.outlook.office365.com (M365 cloud, not on-prem Exchange). smtp-ntlm-info returned nothing; AUTH only after STARTTLS (standard O365). No open relay or NTLM disclosure.
